clean.text:
v8 Watermarking Lab Edition

One lab for watermark families

Explore taxonomy-driven watermark families, compare capabilities, run demo embed operations and inspect cross-family detection output.

Unicode Lexical Syntactic Sampling Semantic Training-time

Demo embedding

Choose one family and run its demo embed pathway.

Run a demo embed operation to inspect output.

Lab output

Family matrix and detector results

HTMX target 
Load families or run detect-all to inspect the lab surface.

Capability axes

Visibility
Visible / subtle / invisible
Robustness
Fragile to high
Detectability
Public, private, keyed
Requirements
Text, decoder, parser or model

Document formats

Normalize or export text for docx, md, txt, rtf, odt, pdf and epub workflows.

Document API responses will appear here.

Large PDF optimization

PyMuPDF-first extraction, page-window processing and cache-aware handling for large PDFs.

Recommended path

  • Use chunked uploads instead of full in-memory reads.
  • Extract only the required page window.
  • Prefer plain text extraction and skip image-rich modes.
  • Cache repeated page-window requests by file hash.
PDF strategy responses will appear here.

RAG chunking

Chunk long text for retrieval with fixed, recursive, markdown-aware, page-aware or semantic-lite strategies.

Chunking results will appear here.

LLM text rewriting

Rewrite text through Ollama locally or through hosted KI APIs such as OpenAI and Anthropic.

LLM rewriting output will appear here.

Prompt templates & versioning

Manage versioned prompt assets, render variables and keep model-linked prompt metadata outside application code.

Inspect the prompt registry with versions, channels and changelog data.

Prompt registry results will appear here.

Automatic prompt optimization

Generate candidate rewrites, score them against a golden set and promote the winner back into the prompt registry.

Optimizer results will appear here.

Multi-agent feedback loop

Generator, critic, refiner, judge and promoter work together to improve prompt quality before promotion.

Multi-agent loop results will appear here.

Graph knowledge representation

Store entities and typed relationships, ingest facts and retrieve subgraphs for agent context.

Browse schema and subgraphs.

Graph results will appear here.

Community detection & summarization

Cluster the graph into thematic groups and generate concise summaries for each community.

Generate and inspect community summaries.

Community results will appear here.

Auto-correction & rewrite engine

Correct grammar, normalize style, and rewrite text while preserving protected facts such as numbers, names, and quotes.

Rewrite results will appear here.

Export module

Export analysis, summaries, or rewritten text in multiple formats and visual styles.

Export details will appear here.

Direct cloud storage upload

Generate a short-lived direct-upload URL, then confirm the upload after the browser sends bytes straight to object storage.

Cloud upload details will appear here.

Local LLM: EuroLLM GGUF

Direct configuration for mradermacher/EuroLLM-9B-Instruct-2512-GGUF via a local OpenAI-compatible llama.cpp server.

Suggested start command:

llama-server -hf mradermacher/EuroLLM-9B-Instruct-2512-GGUF:Q4_K_M --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080
Local LLM status will appear here.

Automatic model fallback routing

Select a primary model, apply deterministic fallback chains, and route requests based on task, privacy, and context needs.

Routing patterns typically use a primary model with a tested fallback ladder, separate handling for 429 versus timeouts, and distinct strategies for context overflow and invalid outputs.

Routing decisions will appear here.
